sampling.first_pass: one cold and one warm observation per case/variant, plus separate profile
sampling.supplement: second cold observation completed for four cases; one unmatched project observation retained
sampling.stopped_reason: Large host/storage latency variance; no observations removed for being slow.

metric_definitions.local_wall_seconds: cli.main time including source reads, real durable receipts and final artifacts, minus measured synthetic-provider reply time
metric_definitions.exclusions: Package imports, fixture construction/readback/removal, actual transport child startup, HTTP/TLS and Jev latency
metric_definitions.cold: Fresh worker for each case; imported harness stdlib and uncontrolled OS/filesystem caches remain
metric_definitions.warm: Second CLI invocation in the same worker with a new fixture directory
metric_definitions.cpu: Parent process CPU during cli.main, including finite reply generation; no transport-child CPU
metric_definitions.receipt: Full real receipt writer time including final fsync/replace, measured externally
metric_definitions.memory: Separate tracemalloc peak increment during actual request planning; input objects exist before tracing
metric_definitions.profile: Separate cProfile runs; self-time categories are nonoverlapping, inclusive hotspots overlap

interruption_audit.note: Synthetic fixed-reply transport only; remaining partial rows excluded from timings.
